description: Dashboard view art (Phase 2) in src/views/HomeView.vue: hero banner + welcome banner overlay, 6 feature-card thumbnails, quick-action card art, panel-header art, New Campaign button art, footer quote ornament. Independent of other view FEATs; depends on FEAT-001 tokens.
steps: In src/views/HomeView.vue add a full-width hero using /assets/dashboard/dashboard-hero-background.png, overlay /assets/dashboard/dashboard-welcome-banner.png on the left 55%, and position the existing 'Welcome back, Dungeon Master' heading over the right portion in white with a subtle text-shadow.

Add a thumbnail (width:100%; height:160px; object-fit:cover; border-radius:8px 8px 0 0) to each of the 6 feature cards, mapping by features[].icon/title: document-library-thumbnail.png->Document Library, campaign-management-thumbnail.png->Campaign Management, character-sheets-thumbnail.png->Character Sheets, dice-roller-thumbnail.png->Dice Roller, ai-dm-runtime-thumbnail.png->AI DM Runtime, adventure-generation-thumbnail.png->Adventure Generation (all under /assets/dashboard/).

Apply the 4 quick-action card arts (quick-action-start-ai-dm-card/import-documents-card/create-character-card/roll-dice-card.png) as background-image (background-size:cover) on the four quick-action RouterLinks, with label text positioned over the right 70%.

Add two panel headers using quick-actions-panel-art.png and recent-campaigns-panel-art.png as background-image with heading text overlaid over the right 75% (introduce the panel sections if not present, keeping existing links/content).
Apply /assets/dashboard/new-campaign-button-art.png as background-image (background-size:100% 100%) on the New Campaign button, text overlaid.
Add a footer area with /assets/dashboard/footer-quote-ornament.png and the italic quote: Great stories aren't just imagined. They're played.
acceptance_criteria: HomeView renders the hero with welcome banner overlay and all 6 feature thumbnails via absolute /assets/dashboard/... paths.
Quick-action cards, panel headers, New Campaign button, and footer ornament are wired with the specified background-size rules.
No CSS border added on top of button art.
`npm run build` succeeds and `npm test` passes.
